description: This file defines an Angular service 'DataService' responsible for fetching food categories and items from an API or fallback mock data. It includes internal methods for building headers and filtering mock data, and exposes public methods for retrieving categories, items, and item details.

classes.name: DataService
classes.description: Angular service for fetching food data, supporting API calls with fallback to mock data.

methods.name: getCategories
methods.description: Fetches food categories from API or returns mock categories on failure.

methods.name: getItems
methods.description: Retrieves food items filtered by categoryId and search query from API or mock data on failure.

methods.name: getItemById
methods.description: Fetches a specific food item by ID from API or returns mock data if unavailable.

methods.name: buildAuthHeaders
methods.description: Constructs authorization headers using the AuthService token.

methods.name: fetchFn (getter)
methods.description: Provides a fetch function, either native or undefined if unavailable.

methods.name: filterMock
methods.description: Filters the mock food items based on categoryId and search terms.
